d: We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused, and solution-oriented Customer Success Specialist to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction, building long-term relationships, supporting customers throughout their journey, and helping them achieve maximum value from the company's products and services.
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers.
Understand customer needs, expectations, and business objectives.
Guide customers through onboarding and ensure a smooth transition.
Proactively engage with customers to monitor satisfaction and identify potential concerns.
Provide timely assistance and effective solutions to customer queries and challenges.
Conduct regular follow-ups to ensure customer success and satisfaction.
Identify opportunities to improve customer retention, loyalty, and engagement.
Monitor customer feedback and identify areas for service improvement.
Coordinate with sales, support, and operations teams to resolve customer issues.
Maintain accurate customer records, interactions, and progress updates in the CRM system.
Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling where appropriate.
Track customer success metrics and prepare regular performance reports.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a relevant field.
1–2 years of experience in customer success, customer service, client relations, or account management (preferred).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Customer-centric mindset with a proactive approach.
Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
Familiarity with CRM software and MS Office.
Strong organizational, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and meet deadlines.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction and business growth.

Directs and motivates team while personally assisting in the physical set up of the function rooms (e.g., tables, chairs, dance floors, podiums, etc.) and executing events based on requirements and standards. Develops and directs team to provide consistent, high quality service. Communicates performance expectations and trains staff in processes. Monitors and controls financial and administrative responsibilities including asset protection.
q: High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, or related professional area.
Ensures Red Coat program is in place in accordance with Catering Event Service minimum standard.
Delegates tasks to ensure room sets are “on time” and meet Event Service Standards.
Manages departmental inventories and assets including par levels and maintenance of equipment.
Projects supply needs for the department (e.g., pads, pens, candy jars, bottled water/water pitchers).
Manages departmental inventories and maintains equipment.
Ensures candy rotation on all meeting room sets (if applicable).
Establishes consistent standards for regular meeting room sets and VIP meeting room sets.
Conducts function room inspections prior to each function to ensure the room is set according to specifications.
Maintains cleanliness and sanitation standards in all banquet operation areas.
Coordinates routine maintenance to ensure a quality meeting facility.
Acts as a liaison between Banquets, Event Planning, Event Delivery teams and the group contact throughout the event.
Coordinates the necessary departments to maintain the meeting room standards.
Reviews the Diary weekly to ensure space maximization.
Ensures function rooms are set according to event documentation (Banquet Event Orders, resumes, etc.) and customer requirements.
Makes presence known to customer at all times.
Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Sets service goals for event service supervisors and employees in order to achieve Event Planner satisfaction goals.
Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
Leads shifts and actively participates in the servicing of events.
Communicates and executes departmental and property emergency procedures and ensures staff are trained in safety procedures.
Conducts monthly department meetings with Event Service staff.
Schedules employees to ensure shift coverage and meet business demands and productivity goals; critiques any variances.

d: Build and maintain secure, reliable and recoverable IT environments, taking responsibility for implementation quality and ongoing operation. Bring practical technical depth to the team by investigating how systems work, testing assumptions, identifying configuration weaknesses and recommending proportionate improvements. Deliver systems that are tested, documented and supportable by other team members.
q: Experience in a small IT team, MSP, hosting provider or infrastructure integrator with direct responsibility for implementation and maintenance.
Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration.
Cloud infrastructure configuration across AWS, Azure or GCP.
DNS, domains, SSL certificates, reverse proxies and web hosting.
Device management, SSO and centralised access controls.
Monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Zabbix or PRTG.
Bash, PowerShell or Python for controlled administrative tasks.
Experience supporting multiple clients or business entities.
Personal projects or lab environments demonstrating practical building, testing and troubleshooting.

r: Translate requirements into working systems, configurations and services.
Personally install and configure servers, virtual machines, networking components, hosted services and business platforms.
Configure dependencies, connectivity, permissions and security controls.
Contribute to larger internal and client infrastructure projects.
Test functionality, performance, security and recovery before handover.
Complete implementations with configuration records, operating procedures and ongoing maintenance requirements.
Evaluate tools against business requirements, security, reliability, and cost.
Review existing configurations, identifying weaknesses, complexity and risks.
Challenge assumptions made by colleagues and senior team members.
Explain technical trade-offs clearly and remain open to alternatives.
Follow agreed decision procedures, escalating unresolved technical risks.
Maintain servers, VMs, cloud services, networks and firewalls.
Monitor availability, performance, capacity and system logs.
Complete patching, upgrades, backups and restore tests on schedule.
Identify unreliable components, and recommend improvements.
Investigate recurring incidents and implement lasting fixes.
Resolve infrastructure, server, connectivity, access and hosting issues.
Diagnose faults using logs, monitoring data, and controlled testing.
Distinguish symptoms from causes and verify fixes before closing incidents.
Keep internal users, clients and colleagues informed of expected resolution.
Escalate issues beyond the role’s authority or expertise with clear findings and recommended next steps.
Maintain system inventories, records, diagrams and operating procedures.
Record technical decisions, dependencies, findings and known limitations.
Produce recovery instructions that another team member can follow.
Store credentials and recovery information only in approved secure systems.
Share knowledge and provide practical handovers so systems do not depend on one individual.
Deliver assigned work within agreed scope, estimates and deadlines.
Break implementations into tasks, identify dependencies and raise blockers.
Log time accurately against internal and client projects.
Treat time and resources as a cost, avoiding unnecessary complexity.
Provide clear updates on delivery, system condition and outstanding issues.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience building, configuring and maintaining production IT systems and infrastructure.
Demonstrated personal ownership of an implementation from initial requirements through deployment, testing and ongoing support.
Practical production Linux administration experience, including services, permissions, logs, patching and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining virtualisation platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox.
Practical experience with networking, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls and VPN connectivity.
Experience implementing or maintaining backups and personally performing successful restore tests.
Experience configuring user access, permissions, authentication and security controls.
Structured troubleshooting skills, including investigation of faults across multiple system components.
Ability to evaluate tools or configurations, explain trade-offs and support recommendations with evidence.
Ability to question technical assumptions constructively, including those made by senior colleagues.
Experience producing usable technical documentation and following controlled change procedures.
A degree, diploma or equivalent practical experience.
